section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces the 'Current Study,' a seven-day daily diary investigation into the within-person experience of gratitude and loneliness in a gender-balanced sample of community-residing adults. The study aims to replicate and extend previous findings by examining both between-person differences and within-person variabilities, and how these associations differ based on age and gender. Two hypotheses are presented, predicting a negative association between gratitude and loneliness, and differential associations across age and gender.
